text:
jordan: Heads up — after last night's microcode+fw bundle push to ap-south1 racks, we're seeing ~30% of GPU nodes failing to finish OOB init; IPMI sessions are open but consoles hang. Observed serial logs show repeated 'Entity lookup timeout' and 'telemetry flood' messages. Paused rollout. Anyone seeing this elsewhere?

priya: seeing same in eu-west logs, smaller scale. suspect the new fw changed the BMC telemetry sampler default from 5s -> 500ms which would explain queue buildup.

mike: oncall ran runbook 3 (oob-pause + bmc-telemetry-disable) against the canary group, took ~12m to stabilize. We should capture exact commands.

jordan: repro steps i ran: 1) push fw v2.3.1-bundle to rack; 2) BMCs start IPMI session spam; 3) NVMe init delays cascade -> kubelet NodeReady flaps -> pod evictions. Sample logs: `ipmi: session flood from 10.0.12.34`, `bmc: telemetry_queue overflow`.

rita: concrete workaround: flip telemetry interval back to 2s via ipmi raw (example): `ipmitool -H $BMC -U admin -P redwood raw 0x30 0x40 0x01 0x02` — will need to script and push to the affected rack group.

ops-bot: Deploy Bot: rollout job 202603211200 started -> paused by jordan (:pause_button:).

mike: applied config override to 10 racks (ap-south1 + eu-west canary): `telemetry_interval=2000` and disabled aggressive sampler. CPU and IPMI accept_rate normalized; GPU allocation backlog cleared on those racks.

priya: quick cost hit calc: ~40 GPU-minutes delayed at peak spot rates -> ~ $120 extra this window. Also increased scheduler churn. We'll include estimate in postmortem.

jordan: action items: 1) add telemetry-interval check to firmware preflight; 2) plan targeted rollback for racks that still have v2.3.1; 3) open vendor ticket for telemetry defaults; 4) re-run canary with phased host-level ramp + updated runbook.

rita: I'll draft runbook edits (add ipmi raw commands + oob-proxy throttle step) and open the vendor ticket. Also propose adding an OOB proxy config to limit concurrent IPMI sessions to 200 to blunt floods.

mike: logging snippet we captured: ```[bmc] telemetry_queue len=4096 -> overflow at 2026-03-21T01:12:05Z
[ipmi] sessions: 2000 -> accept_rate 700/s
[kubelet] eviction: pods due to NodeReady false``` — saving full traces to /var/logs/fw-rollout/ap-south1/618888.

jordan: good. tagging eng-oncall and eng-infra for follow-up. @priya can you estimate rollback window for eu-west? :wave:

priya: rollback ~45m per rack including image revert + sanity reboot. Recommend low-traffic window; I'll coordinate with sales scheduling and post a plan in #release-war-room. :+1:

rita: noted — I'll attach the runbook draft and the vendor ticket link once created.

mike: next steps: capture diff between v2.3.0 and v2.3.1 telemetry defaults, add automated guard, and schedule phased retry for +10% hosts per hour.

jordan: thanks all. if anyone sees new NodeReady flaps, ping here and we'll re-run the pause. :eyes:
